errors.network: can't reach the laptop running torta. check the wifi.
errors.already_setup: torta is already set up on this laptop.
errors.bad_backup: that file is not a torta backup.
errors.bad_code: that code did not work. ask for a new one on the laptop.
errors.bad_transition: that order already moved on. refreshing.
errors.barcode_taken: another item already has that barcode.
errors.ingredient_choice: {name} can't be served that way anymore. refreshing.
errors.insert_failed: the order didn't save. try again.
errors.internal: something went wrong on the laptop. try again.
errors.invalid_input: something in the form isn't right.
errors.modifier_count: pick the right number of options for {name}.
errors.needs_setup: finish setting up torta on the laptop first.
errors.not_found: that's gone. it may have been deleted.
errors.too_many_attempts: too many tries. wait a minute.
errors.unauthorized: this device needs to sign in or pair again.
errors.unknown_ingredient: an ingredient changed on the menu. refreshing.
errors.unknown_item: an item changed on the menu. refreshing.
errors.unknown_modifier: an option changed on the menu. refreshing.

pair.title: pair with {name}
pair.description: on the laptop, open admin and tap add device to get a code.
pair.ios: on iphone or ipad, add this page to the home screen first, then open it from there and pair.

admin.setupDescription: name the place and pick an admin password.
admin.passwordHint: at least 8 characters. needed to manage the menu from a tablet.

overview.openOnWifi: open this on the same wifi
overview.noNetwork: no wifi or ethernet address found. connect the laptop to the restaurant network.
overview.codesNote: new devices need a code. codes last 5 minutes and work once.
overview.removeConfirm: remove {name}? it will have to pair again.
overview.pairDescription: scan the code, or open the address and type the number.

sales.title: sales
sales.timelineHint: tap a bar to see its orders below. tap it again to see all.
sales.afterFoodHint: sales before tax, minus food cost and waste
sales.empty: no completed orders in this range.
sales.addOrderHint: for orders taken on paper or while torta was off. it is saved as completed and priced from the current menu.
sales.pastOnly: pick a time that has already happened.
sales.deleteConfirm: delete {order} for good? it leaves sales and inventory.
sales.itemTimelineHint: tap items to add or remove them from the chart.
sales.itemsSoldHint: tap items to see them on the chart. pick several to compare them together.
sales.ordersHint: tap a name to see only that customer's orders.

settings.title: settings
settings.taxesDescription: when tax is off, orders charge none and the sales page leaves it out. the rate is kept for when you turn it back on.
settings.backupDescription: this laptop is the only copy of your menu and sales. keep a file somewhere else.
settings.licenseDescription: torta is free software under the agpl-3.0.

menu.title: menu
menu.noCategories: start with a category: tacos, drinks, sides.
menu.ingredientsEmpty: what's in it, like onion or cilantro. servers can change how each one is served.
menu.modifiersEmpty: choices made on each order, like tortilla, salsa or size.
menu.groupHint: the question, like tortilla, salsa or size
menu.ruleRange: must pick at least one, maybe more
menu.ingredientHint: something already in it, like onion or salsa.
menu.servedAs: besides regular, servers can make it
menu.inventoryFirst: to track how much it uses and what it costs, add it on the {link} page first.

inventory.title: inventory
inventory.empty: add what you buy, what it costs and how much you have. menu items can then say how much they use, and sales will show what the food cost.
inventory.deleteConfirm: delete {name}? menu items that use it keep the ingredient, without an amount.
inventory.barcodeHint: optional. scan it or type it.
inventory.freshCount: changing this counts as a fresh stock count.
inventory.countHint: what should be left is pre-filled. fix it if the shelf says otherwise.

kitchen.empty: nothing to cook. orders appear here as they are sent.
kitchen.foodMadeNote: its ingredients count as used in inventory.

order.cantEdit: #{n} has items that are no longer on the menu, so it can't be edited here.
order.finishFirst: send or clear this order before editing another.
order.noMenu: no menu yet. add items in admin.
order.empty: tap items to start an order
order.taxNote: tax is added by the server
order.employeeMealNote: cooked and counted in inventory, charged nothing.
